nodes.title: The older family (class 4-9) picks its picture from 12 line emblems (orbit, comet, bolt, prism, wave, peak, atom, delta, nova, helix, grid, flare) drawn in code on chamfered dark tiles in the look's hues, in Hello and Me; the young family keeps the painted animals, and any picture a child already chose still renders. Plus: Hello's older likes line 'Your parent picked these. Still you?', paired actions never wrap, and the compact face never clips 'AI teacher'. Reverse: the owner wants a commissioned identity set, or children ask for the animals.

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-app-older-emblems`
This came from the 9-15 onboarding sweep. The first thing a 13-year-old chose was a cartoon red panda in a circle, which is exactly the 'looks like it's for a 5-year-old' the owner flagged. Older children now pick an emblem in the same visual language as the rest of the app. Nothing a child already chose changes, and younger children keep the animals. The sweep found nothing babyish in the parent set-up (Learning's screens).
